balance:
# All gameplay tunables (D-005). Shared by every target.
# Values are converted once to fixed-point at load time and hashed after conversion (D-011).
# Global rules only; per-species stats live in species.toml (D-029). Values are placeholders.

[sim]
tick_hz = 10             # §4 fixed tick
flora_every_ticks = 8    # §5.3: flora fields at 1.25 Hz (D-038; keep growth x dt <= 1)
env_every_ticks = 10     # §5.3: nutrients / water at 1 Hz
grid_size = 64           # §5.1: 1 cell = 4 m, a 256 m map (D-047, D-049)
chunk_size = 32          # §5.3 chunk sleeping, hashing

[match]
players = 2
victory_territory = 0.60 # §2.3, Q-013
time_limit_s = 1200      # §2.3: 20 min, Q-013
territory_decay = false  # [Proposed] switch (gamerules §11.3): threshold decays linearly ...
territory_start = 0.75   # ... from this at t = 0 ...
territory_end = 0.55     # ... to this at the time limit

[agents]
max_agents = 2000        # §5.4 budget; per player: half

[net]
input_delay_ticks = 2    # §10: 200 ms at 10 Hz
stall_timeout_s = 10     # §10
hash_every_ticks = 10    # §10: desync check once per second

# Terrain (gamerules §2.3). V1: flat, loam, constant water and light. Species may add optional
# water_optimum / water_tolerance, light_optimum / light_tolerance (0..1; tolerance 0 = indifferent)
# and soil_affinity = { sandy = 1.2, ... }; absent keys are neutral (D-024).
[terrain]
water = 0.5
light = 1.0
soil_types = ["loam", "sandy", "clay_limestone"]

# Flora cell model (gamerules §2.1, §3; D-019). Species stats are in species.toml.
# Rates are per second; fractions are of the species' k_max. Biomass is in u16 units (0..65535).
[flora]
seed_fraction = 0.1        # seed rain: biomass added per unit of gauge gained, as a fraction of k_max
establish_threshold = 0.1  # a stratum counts for the dominant level from this fraction
smother_rate = 0.15        # enemy strata lose this fraction of k_max per second, per attacking neighbour
litter_fraction = 0.1      # litter per second = this x biomass_rate x biomass (turnover)
niche_overlap = 0.5        # [Proposed] competition between species of one stratum (1 = full overlap, D-022)
soil_min_level = [0.1, 0.3, 0.6]  # soil development for full suitability: L1 (non-pioneers), L2, L3
soil_ramp = 0.1           # suitability ramps from 0 at soil_min - soil_ramp to 1 at soil_min (D-024)
plant_gauge = 0.5         # colonization gauge of a freshly planted species (D-024)
plant_radius = 2          # a plant order seeds a disc of this radius, in cells (gamerules §7.1; D-042)
# [Proposed] rules behind switches (D-019)
succession = true
shade = true
contested_cells = true

# Fauna agents (gamerules §5.2, §6; D-023, D-026). Species stats are in species.toml.
[fauna]
transfer = 0.1          # share of eaten biomass that becomes the eater's energy (10 % rule)
own_graze = 0.2         # bite on own flora, relative to enemy flora (gamerules §10)
soil_per_dead = 0.5     # soil development (u16 units) per unit of dead biomass decomposed
herbivore_range = 10    # prototype only (tools/prototype): sim-core drops herbivores near the click
drop_radius = 4         # a drop (herbivores off own land, predators) lands within this many cells of the click (D-061)
flee_radius = 3         # prey flee enemy hunters closer than this
refuge_flora = ["hawthorn", "bramble"]
refuge_cover = 0.5      # summed cover of refuge flora that hides small fauna (D-023)
# Local carrying capacity (D-066): a birth needs food nearby, within the species' sight.
food_reserve = 900      # grazers, decomposers: seconds of bites the food in sight must hold per animal
prey_per_predator = 4   # predators: huntable enemy prey in sight per predator
strike_radius = 1       # a predator catches prey up to this many cells away (each axis), once per flora tick
catch_chance = 0.5      # chance that a hunting predator with prey in reach makes its kill, per flora tick
# Organic movement (D-065): steering at any angle, plus a Brownian drift and scattered targets.
wobble = 0.35           # random kick to an animal's drift each tick, as a share of its speed
wobble_keep = 0.8       # share of the drift kept from one tick to the next (0 = white noise)
scatter = 0.4           # food and order targets: random offset from the cell centre (cells, < 0.5)
wander_radius = 1.5     # an idle animal strolls to a random point this far away at most (cells)

# Economy (gamerules §4, §7; D-027, D-029). Costs and yields are per species (species.toml).
[economy]
start_budget = 1000
drop_surcharge = 1.5         # any animal landing outside own land costs more (§6.3; D-061)
species:
# species.toml — per-species stats (D-029). Tune freely; values are placeholders.
# Loaded together with balance.toml (both are converted and hashed together, D-011).
#
# Stats (first block of each species):
#   growth       plants: colonization gauge speed at full pressure (1/s)
#                animals: minimum seconds between two births of a well-fed animal
#   spawn_cost   plants: points per cell planted; animals: points per animal
#   unlock_cost  points to unlock the species card (0 = available at start)
#   yield        points per second: per fully covered cell (plants), per animal (animals)
#   cap          plants: share of the map's cells per player (0..1, D-045); animals: max animals per player
#   effect       special effect, shown in the UI
#
# Model (second block): level / tier = tech-tree position (flora L1..L3, fauna F1..F5).
#   Plants: biomass_rate = logistic r (1/s); k_max = biomass capacity of a cell (u16);
#   shade_cast / shade_tolerance 0..1; soil_gain = soil development per second at full cover.
#   Animals: role, eats, habitat (flora names or L1..L3; predators eat fauna names), small =
#   can hide in a refuge, body (energy capacity), bite (1/s), upkeep (share of body per s),
#   speed and sight (cells), group (animals per spawned card).
